images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 914 Vance Str

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a Craftsman 1.5-storey bungalow with a gabled porch on tapered posts over brick piers, a triple gable window, a shed dormer on the side; a Victorian cottage with a spindle porch on one side, a two-storey porch house on the other

why.note: the Craftsman signature: tapered posts on brick piers
